Echinacea (Echinacea purpurea)

Remedy immune infection UTI prostatitis anti-inflammatory

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Echinacea is well-known for immune support and UTI prevention. For prostatitis, it reduces inflammation and supports immune response against bacterial infection when used at onset of symptoms.

Indications

  • urinary tract infections
  • immune support
  • prostatitis
  • inflammation

Contraindications

  • autoimmune conditions
  • tuberculosis (use caution)

Preparations

  • tea
  • tincture
  • extract
  • capsule

Botanical Information

Botanical Name: Echinacea purpurea

Family: Asteraceae

Common Names: Echinacea, Purple Coneflower, Snakeroot

Parts Used: aerial parts, root

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Enlarged Prostate (Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia / BPH)
    Enlarged prostate (benign prostatic hyperplasia) is a non-cancerous enlargement of the prostate gland common in older men. Symptoms include difficulty starting urination, weak urine stream, frequent urination, nocturia (waking at night to urinate), and incomplete bladder emptying. It can progress to urinary retention requiring medical intervention.
